name: JavaScript - Interactive Application
description: Create a complete interactive web application

rules.text: Create a simple calculator interface with input fields and buttons

checkParams.function: (code) => { const inputs = (code.match(/<input/gi) || []).length; const buttons = (code.match(/<button/gi) || []).length; return inputs >= 2 && buttons >= 1; }

rules.text: Create a calculate function that performs math operations
rules.hint: Write function: function calculate() { let a = parseInt(document.getElementById("num1").value); let b = parseInt(document.getElementById("num2").value); let sum = a + b; document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = sum; }

rules.text: Add form validation to check for empty inputs
rules.hint: Add validation: if (num1.value === "" || num2.value === "") { alert("Please enter both numbers!"); return; } Always validate user input!
